title: Format a date
description: formatDate(iso) turns an ISO timestamp into "DD/MM/YYYY" using UTC, so the result never depends on the machine's time zone. For example "2024-03-05T23:30:00Z" becomes "05/03/2024". formatTimeline(list) formats a list of timestamps, oldest first.
hint: Check both the day and the month of "2024-03-05" by hand.
